mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.package_code AS packageCode, p.package_name AS packageName, p.package_type AS packageType, p.status, p.max_user_count AS maxUserCount, p.max_dept_count AS maxDeptCount, p.max_storage_mb AS maxStorageMb, p.max_api_per_minute AS maxApiPerMinute, p.feature_flags_json AS featureFlagsJson, p.sort_no AS sortNo, p.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plat_tenant t WHERE t.package_id = p.id AND t.deleted = 0) AS activeTenantCount FROM plat_tenant_package p WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.package_code AS packageCode, p.package_name AS packageName, p.package_type AS packageType, p.status, p.max_user_count AS maxUserCount, p.max_dept_count AS maxDeptCount, p.max_storage_mb AS maxStorageMb, p.max_api_per_minute AS maxApiPerMinute, p.feature_flags_json AS featureFlagsJson, p.sort_no AS sortNo, p.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plat_tenant t WHERE t.package_id = p.id AND t.deleted = 0) AS activeTenantCount FROM plat_tenant_package p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0
